mapper.select: SELECT admin_id AS adminId, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, nickname, account_status AS accountStatus, last_login_time AS lastLoginTime, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM admin_account WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_account SET last_login_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE admin_id = #{adminId}
